description: This file handles the creation and editing of custom fields within the vtiger CRM system. It performs validation, checks for duplicate fields, determines the appropriate database table and field types, and updates the database schema accordingly. The script also manages picklist options and ensures proper integration with CRM entities.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class providing access to CRM entity information and table configurations.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the specified CRM entity class.
